title: Pasulka meets Tyler and begins an emergent collaboration

tellings.quote: meets this person named Tyler who's part of the first tradition right the secret tradition and what happens is a collaboration and then a transparency that we've never seen before

plain: A man named Tyler, said to belong to a secret tradition of people who quietly know about UFOs, met a scholar and the two began working together, opening up "a transparency that we've never seen before." Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and UFOs, tells this about her own meeting with Tyler over the years from about 2010. She presents it as a rare case of the hidden side sharing what it knows.
